calibration_definition: Draw e=b[index]-mean(b); compare base+signal+e > linear q95(b-mean(b)). This targets the positive tail of mean-zero empirical historical variation; not a 5% out-of-sample false-alarm guarantee.
calibration_rationale: Align the threshold with the actual simulated mean-zero disturbance distribution. Preserve uncentred historical-threshold version explicitly; do not tune for 5% or a dose.

dose_denominator: Candidate observed pre-window total units / 21 per-day, item-specific shares. Dose is eventual daily intensity; realized units saved separately. Equal cumulative normalizes realized observed additions.
